metadata.name: deadroll_session
metadata.description: Deadroll session: party, turns, combat, VRF callback, escrow.

instructions.name: act
docs: Player attacks with the weapon (`0xFF`) or one of the active skills taken onto the map:
spends AP, requests VRF.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Main wallet or the participation's session key; pays the VRF fee.

accounts.name: skill_set
docs: `read_skill`, and the callback burns it if the character dies.

accounts.name: monsters
docs: Read-only, never Borsh-decoded: owner and discriminator checked here, session in `Monsters`.

accounts.name: target_participation
docs: The ally a heal or buff targets when it is not the caster; `None` for every other action
(a self-cast, an attack, a debuff). Any `Participation` of this session; the handler
checks its slot.

accounts.name: layout
docs: `open_session`, read by `MapLayoutView`.

instructions.name: claim_escrow
docs: After the party ended: the DM takes the escrow and the map goes `Finished`.

accounts.name: dm
docs: DM main wallet only: this moves lamports (docs/GAME_COMMISSIONS.md, section 4).

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: After the party ended: rewards and unlock for one character (its owner or their session key).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The character's owner (the participation's `player`) or its session key.

instructions.name: consume_randomness
docs: VRF callback: resolves the pending attack through `deadroll_combat`, applies HP and
states, death (`character.mark_dead`), boss victory and wipe.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: The VRF program's identity for this program (`mock-vrf`: the fixed test identity).

accounts.name: session
docs: State checks run here, before the pending-accounts checks below: once a roll is resolved
`pending` is cleared, and a late callback must read `NoRollPending`, not a wrong account.

accounts.name: participation
docs: The player side of the hit, the one recorded by `act` / `monster_act`.

accounts.name: character
docs: longer written here (a death is finalized by `start_turn` or a claim); kept writable so the
account list stays the same.

accounts.name: skill_set
docs: from its seeds): the caster's skills. Patch 6: not burned here any more (see `character`).

accounts.name: bag
docs: unused here, kept for the account list.

accounts.name: session_authority
docs: any more; kept for the account list (with `config` and `character_program`).

accounts.name: target_participation
docs: The ally of a heal or buff that is not the caster (`session.pending_target`); `None`
for every other roll.

accounts.name: layout
docs: need the walls. Address pinned at `open_session`, read by `MapLayoutView`.

instructions.name: end_turn
docs: Ends the current unit's turn and starts the next living unit's.

accounts.name: signer
docs: On a player's turn: their main wallet or session key. On a monster's turn: the DM's.

accounts.name: monsters
docs: mutable `LazyAccount` would re-serialize the whole account on exit).

accounts.name: participation
docs: Required on a player's turn: the participation whose turn it is.

instructions.name: flee
docs: Player chooses "Escape" on their turn; the party flees when every living player did.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Main wallet or the participation's session key.

instructions.name: join_session
docs: Player joins with a character and pays a share of the price into escrow.

accounts.name: player
docs: Main wallet that owns the character. Pays the contribution and the account rent.

instructions.name: monster_act
docs: DM: the current monster attacks a player slot; same VRF path as `act`.

accounts.name: signer
docs: DM main wallet or the DM's session key; pays the VRF fee.

accounts.name: participation
docs: The target player's participation; for a heal or buff on a monster (patch 6), the
participation of the lowest living player slot (the callback's account list is fixed).

accounts.name: layout
docs: `open_session`, read by `MapLayoutView`.

instructions.name: monster_move
docs: DM moves a monster along a path on that monster's turn.

accounts.name: signer
docs: DM main wallet or the DM's session key; pays the VRF fee when the move triggers a
reactive skill.

accounts.name: monsters
docs: mutable `LazyAccount` would re-serialize the whole account on exit).

instructions.name: move_unit
docs: Player moves along a path of grid steps on their turn.

accounts.name: signer
docs: Main wallet or the participation's session key; pays the VRF fee when the move triggers a
monster's reactive skill (patch 6).

accounts.name: monsters
docs: Read-only, never Borsh-decoded: owner and discriminator checked here, session in `Monsters`.

instructions.name: open_session
docs: DM opens a party on a finalized map: session, monsters and escrow; map goes `InSession`.

accounts.name: bestiary
docs: is copied into `MonsterState.records`.

accounts.name: monster_skills
docs: pools, copied into `MonsterState`.

instructions.name: set_ready
docs: Player marks (or unmarks) ready in the lobby, main wallet only. Ready takes `selection`
onto the map (4 active, 1 reactive, 1 passive `SkillSet` indexes) and locks the character;
unready unlocks it.

accounts.name: player
docs: Main wallet only: readiness is not a game move (docs/PARTY_AND_TURNS.md, section 2.1).

accounts.name: skill_extras
docs: (owner, discriminator and character checked); address from the seeds.

instructions.name: start_session
docs: DM starts the party once everyone is ready and the price is collected: requests the
initiative roll; `consume_randomness` writes the turn order.

accounts.name: dm
docs: DM main wallet; pays the VRF fee of the initiative roll.

accounts.name: monsters
docs: Read-only, never Borsh-decoded: owner and discriminator checked here, session in
`Monsters`; passed on to the callback.

instructions.name: start_turn
docs: Starts the current unit's turn, before anything else on it (permissionless): over-time
damage (same death and victory path as hits), Freeze / Stun skip the turn, state
durations and cooldowns count down. A skip or a death ends the turn on its own.

accounts.name: participation
docs: Required on a player's turn: the participation whose turn it is.

accounts.name: character
docs: the handler); written by `character::mark_dead` when over-time damage kills.

accounts.name: skill_set
docs: `SkillSet`, burned by `character::mark_dead` (which checks its seeds).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Any participant: pays the VRF fee when the turn start triggers a reactive skill.

types.name: AccuracyBuffData
docs: `deadroll_combat::AccuracyBuff`.

fields.name: aspect
docs: Attacks with a packet of this aspect get the bonus.

fields.name: turns
docs: Own turn starts until it ends.

fields.name: bonus
docs: Added to the d20.

types.name: ActionRequested
docs: An attack waits for its VRF value.

fields.name: action
docs: `GameSession.action_counter` of this action; `HitResolved` carries the same number.

fields.name: skill_slot
docs: Player skill slot (`0xFF` = weapon), or the monster action.

types.name: ActiveState
docs: A state on a unit. `turns == 0` marks an empty slot.

fields.name: power
docs: Strength of the state (damage per turn for DoT, basis points for slows).

fields.name: source
docs: Turn-order slot of the unit that applied it.

types.name: Applied
docs: `deadroll_combat::Applied`.

types.name: Aspect
docs: Damage aspect (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md).

types.name: AuraChanged
docs: An aura started, or ended (`aura.turns == 0`): docs/SKILL_BUILDER.md, section 3.5. Passive
auras start at `set_ready(true)` and end at `set_ready(false)` or the bearer's death.

fields.name: bearer
docs: Player slot of the bearer.

fields.name: aura_slot
docs: `0` the passive skill's aura, `1` the reactive skill's.

types.name: AuraData
docs: `deadroll_rules::aura::Aura`.

fields.name: turns
docs: Own turn starts of the bearer until it ends, `255` = permanent (a passive), 0 = none.

fields.name: hostile
docs: A debuff aura (on the enemies around).

fields.name: passive
docs: From a passive skill.

fields.name: self_only
docs: A passive skill without an aura: on its bearer only.

types.name: BurningCellData
docs: `deadroll_rules::spread::BurningCell`.

fields.name: until_round
docs: Burns through this round.

fields.name: power
docs: Burning per turn on whoever steps in.

fields.name: source
docs: Turn-order id of the unit that set it on fire.

types.name: Carrier
docs: `deadroll_combat::Carrier`.

types.name: Category
docs: Section 3: active (4 slots), reactive (1), passive (1).

types.name: Cell
docs: A map cell coordinate.

types.name: CellBurned
docs: A unit stepped into a burning cell and caught fire (`move_unit`, `monster_move`).

fields.name: unit
docs: Turn-order id.

fields.name: states
docs: The unit's states after.

types.name: DeathFinalized
docs: Patch 6: the death of a player who went down in a VRF callback is final: `character.mark_dead`
ran (the tombstone; skills, bag and soulbound items burn). `PlayerDied` came at the fall.

types.name: Effect
docs: Section 6. `None` only for pure damage. Debuffs and hard control first, then buffs;
`Heal` was appended later (a buff kind: restores HP up to the maximum), then `Resistance`
(patch 9: resistance to the skill's aspects and the bearer's predisposition).

types.name: EffectResolved
docs: A resolved heal, buff or debuff (`act` with such a skill: instead of `HitResolved`), or the
effect of a damage skill after its hit (`rider`: right after that action's `HitResolved`).
Every roll is in `roll`; the website can replay it from `seed` (`deadroll_combat::support`).

fields.name: caster
docs: Turn-order ids: the caster and the unit the effect went to.

fields.name: seed
docs: The VRF value of this action.

fields.name: action_counter
docs: `GameSession.action_counter` of this action, the same number as its `ActionRequested`.

fields.name: effect
docs: The skill's effect.

fields.name: rider
docs: The effect of a damage skill, rolled after the hit on the next dice of the same seed.

fields.name: applied
docs: What it did: `Added` / `Refreshed` (a buff, debuff or Stun), `Froze`, or `None` (a miss,
a heal, or no free slot).

fields.name: hp
docs: The target's HP after (a heal raises it, up to its maximum).

fields.name: states
docs: The target's states and buffs / debuffs after.

fields.name: resist_mod
docs: Patch 9: the target's Resistance after.

types.name: EffectRollData
docs: `deadroll_combat::EffectRoll`: the dice of a heal, buff, debuff or a damage skill's effect.

fields.name: outcome
docs: `Hit`: the effect lands. `Miss`: the d20 or the effect chance failed.

fields.name: d20
docs: The hit roll of a debuff, 0 = none (heals and buffs do not roll to land).

fields.name: chance_bp
docs: Effect chance of a damage skill's effect (0 for heals, buffs and debuffs).

fields.name: chance_roll
docs: `None` when not rolled (not a damage skill's effect, or certain on a crit).

fields.name: amount
docs: HP for a heal, bp for a buff or debuff, 0 for Stun / Freeze or a miss.

types.name: Escrow
docs: `["escrow", session]`: holds the party price contributions as lamports above rent.

fields.name: collected
docs: Contributions received so far.

fields.name: claimed
docs: The DM took `collected` (`claim_escrow`).

types.name: GameSession
docs: `["session", map]`: one party on one map.

fields.name: core
docs: Frozen contract, first after the discriminator.

fields.name: layout
docs: The map's `MapLayout`, read on every move.

fields.name: entrance
docs: Players are placed here when they join.

fields.name: dm_actor
docs: DM session key allowed to move monsters and end their turns (`Pubkey::default()` = none).

fields.name: turn_order_len
docs: Used entries in `core.turn_order`.

fields.name: turn_seq
docs: Bumped on every turn start; action points are granted lazily per `turn_seq`.

fields.name: turn_started_at
docs: Unix time the current turn started (turn timeout, P1).

fields.name: player_pos
docs: Mirror of each player's `Participation` position, for occupancy checks.

fields.name: alive_mask
docs: Bit per player slot: alive.

fields.name: ready_mask
docs: Bit per player slot: ready in the lobby.

fields.name: pending
docs: Valid while `core.pending_vrf`.

fields.name: flee_mask
docs: Bit per player slot: chose "Escape" and nobody took another action since
(docs/PARTY_AND_TURNS.md, section 7.3).

fields.name: settled_mask
docs: Bit per player slot: `claim_rewards` done after the party ended.

fields.name: xp_pool
docs: Experience from killed monsters; every living player gets all of it on victory.

fields.name: victory_seed
docs: VRF value of the boss kill; the reward rolls derive from it.

fields.name: monster_speed
docs: Bestiary speed (action points per turn) of each monster, by monster index.

fields.name: monster_initiative
docs: Bestiary initiative of each monster, by monster index.

fields.name: player_initiative
docs: Initiative of each player slot, set at `join_session`.

fields.name: tile_cost
docs: Step cost in action points per `Tile`, 0 = cannot be entered (registry `Tileset`).

fields.name: acted_seq
docs: `turn_seq` in which the current unit used its one attack or active skill
(docs/PARTY_AND_TURNS.md, 5.1). Only the current unit acts, so one field serves all.

fields.name: started_seq
docs: `turn_seq` whose start ran (`start_turn`): states ticked, cooldowns counted down. Every
other turn instruction waits for it.

fields.name: pending_target
docs: The ally `Participation` a pending heal or buff targets when it is not the caster: the
callback's `target_participation`. `Pubkey::default()` = none.

fields.name: participations
docs: Each player slot's `Participation`, set at `join_session`: the party accounts every VRF
callback gets after its fixed list.

fields.name: reactives
docs: Each player's reactive skill on the map, set at `set_ready(true)`.

fields.name: auras
docs: Each player's auras: its passive skill's (permanent, set at `set_ready(true)`) and its
reactive skill's (temporary).

fields.name: pending_reactive
docs: A pending roll that only resolves reactives (`monster_move`, `start_turn`); `kind == NONE`
for every other roll.

fields.name: pending_monster_reactive
docs: A pending roll that only resolves monster reactives (`move_unit`, `start_turn`);
`kind == NONE` for every other roll.

fields.name: pending_deaths
docs: Players down in a VRF callback whose death is not finalized yet (`character.mark_dead`),
one bit per slot: the queue `start_turn` and the claims finalize first, in slot order.
While it is not empty no turn starts and no action is taken.

fields.name: aura_weights
docs: Each player's auras' aspect weights (a Resistance, `deadroll_rules::aura::Aura::weights_pct`),
by aura slot like `auras`.

types.name: GameSessionData
docs: session `["session", map]`.

types.name: HitItemsData
docs: The items of both sides of a hit.

types.name: HitOutcome
docs: `deadroll_combat::Outcome`.

types.name: HitResolved
docs: One resolved attack, in the shape the website reads (app/src/chain/types.ts). `result` is
the full `deadroll_combat::HitResult` (every roll and per-packet step, Borsh layout of
crates/combat/wasm/README.md); the website can replay it from `seed`. Written by
`hit_event::emit_hit_resolved`, never built on the stack.

fields.name: attacker
docs: Turn-order ids: `0..4` player slot, `4 + i` monster `i`.

fields.name: seed
docs: The VRF value of this action.

fields.name: action_counter
docs: `GameSession.action_counter` of this action, the same number as its `ActionRequested`.

fields.name: items
docs: What the players' worn items put into this hit (weapon base, armor, defense, attack).

types.name: HitResultData
docs: `deadroll_combat::HitResult`: every roll and per-packet step, in roll order. Arrays are full
size; `tint_roll_count` / `packet_count` say how many entries are used.

fields.name: res_ops
docs: Patch 4: per base slot the ops of its resonance (`kind == None` after them).

fields.name: target_mods
docs: Timed modifiers on the target (`target_mods[..target_mod_count]`), with the weights a
`deadroll_combat::TimedMod` carries since patch 9 (zero unless a Resistance).

fields.name: landed
docs: `state_bit`s of the states that landed on the target.

types.name: InitiativeRolled
docs: The turn order, rolled once from the VRF value of `start_session`: per unit `d20 +
initiative`, higher first (ties: higher initiative, then lower unit id). The first `len`
entries are used. `TurnStarted` for the first unit follows.

fields.name: order
docs: Turn-order ids, in turn order.

fields.name: d20
docs: The d20 of `order[i]`.

fields.name: initiative
docs: The initiative bonus of `order[i]`.

types.name: ItemBase
docs: Item base: the type of an item, its slot and base numbers (`deadroll_rules::ItemTuning`).
P0 has the class starter bases (docs/ITEMS_AND_CRAFT.md, section 10); recipes append more.

types.name: ItemBonusData
docs: What a player's worn items put into a hit (`deadroll_rules::items::ItemBonus`), so the
breakdown can show it. All zero / `None` for a monster.

fields.name: weapon
docs: The main-hand weapon whose damage is the base; `None` = bare hands (or a monster).

fields.name: attack
docs: Flat `d20` attack bonus (stat bonuses are already in the totals).

types.name: JumpData
docs: `deadroll_combat::Jump`: a state for the program to pass on (`ResonanceSpread` says where).

types.name: JumpMode
docs: `deadroll_combat::JumpMode`.

types.name: MapSkillData
docs: A skill taken onto the map as the rules see it (`deadroll_rules::input::SkillStats`). The
character is locked for the party, so the copy stays exact.

fields.name: cooldown
docs: In the character's turns, `0` = none.

fields.name: ap_cost
docs: Action points to use it (`0` for reactive and passive skills).

types.name: ModKindData
docs: `deadroll_combat::ModKind`.

types.name: ModsTicked
docs: Buffs and debuffs at the start of a unit's turn (`start_turn`, right after `TurnTicked`).

fields.name: unit
docs: Turn-order id.

fields.name: expired
docs: `deadroll_combat::support::mod_bit` of every buff or debuff that ended now.

fields.name: mods
docs: The unit's buffs and debuffs after the tick (`turns`: own turn starts left).

fields.name: action_points
docs: Action points of this turn: speed with Haste and Slow.

fields.name: resist_mod
docs: Patch 9: the unit's Resistance after the tick.

types.name: Monster
docs: A live monster in a session.

types.name: MonsterAuraChanged
docs: Patch 6: a monster's aura started, or ended (`aura.turns == 0`). A passive one starts at
`open_session` and ends with the bearer's death.

fields.name: bearer
docs: Monster index of the bearer.

fields.name: aura_slot
docs: `0` the passive skill's aura, `1` the reactive skill's.

fields.name: kin_only
docs: On allies of the bearer's kin only.

types.name: MonsterAuraData
docs: `deadroll_rules::aura::Aura` of a monster: an aura plus its kin-only flag.

types.name: MonsterDefenseData
docs: `deadroll_rules::MonsterDefense`: bits by `Aspect` / `StateKind`.

types.name: MonsterReactiveTriggered
docs: Patch 6: a monster's reactive skill triggered by itself (docs/SKILL_BUILDER.md 3.2,
docs/BESTIARY.md 3.2), on the dice of the action that caused it, after the players' reactions.

fields.name: bearer
docs: Monster index of the bearer.

fields.name: skill_slot
docs: The reactive skill's monster slot (`deadroll_rules::monster::REACTIVE_SLOT`).

fields.name: target
docs: Turn-order id the reaction goes to: the player, the buffed monster, or the bearer for an
aura.

types.name: MonsterState
docs: `["monsters", session]`: every monster of the party, spawned from the map layout.
On-chain it is never Borsh-decoded as a whole: `[Monster; 24]` (~1.3 KB) decoded by
`Account<MonsterState>` overflows the 4 KB SBPF v3 stack frame. Contexts take it as
`LazyAccount` (owner + discriminator check, IDL entry) and instructions go through
[`Monsters`], which reads and writes one monster at a time in place. `cargo-build-sbf` still
warns about the generated Borsh decoders (`try_deserialize_unchecked`, `deserialize_reader`)
and the `LazyAccount` loaders (`__load_common`); nothing calls them.

fields.name: core
docs: Frozen contract, first after the discriminator.

fields.name: cooldowns
docs: Not used since patch 6 (`skill_cooldowns` holds every monster slot). Kept for the layout.

fields.name: mods
docs: Per monster: buffs and debuffs (`deadroll_combat::support`), like `Participation.mods`
(the Resistance is in `resist_mods`).

fields.name: defense
docs: Per monster: the defenses of its bestiary record.

fields.name: res_aspects
docs: The registry `aspects`, `traits` and `resonances` table bodies
(`deadroll_combat::tables`).

fields.name: burning_cells
docs: Cells set on fire by a resonance (`deadroll_rules::spread`); `power == 0` is free.

fields.name: records
docs: Per monster: its bestiary record (`deadroll_rules::monster::record`).

fields.name: skill_table
docs: Every skill the spawns took, each once (the session copy of
`deadroll_skillcheck::monster`); the first `skill_count` are used.

fields.name: skills
docs: Per monster, per slot (`0..5` active, `5` reactive, `6` passive): an index into
`skill_table`, `NO_SKILL` (0xFF) = empty.

fields.name: skill_cooldowns
docs: Per monster, per slot: own turn starts until usable (the reactive's too), counted down by
`start_turn`.

fields.name: auras
docs: Per monster: its passive skill's aura (from `open_session`), then its reactive skill's.

fields.name: resist_mods
docs: Per monster: its Resistance with the aspect weights, like `Participation.resist_mod`.

fields.name: aura_weights
docs: Per monster, per aura slot: a Resistance aura's aspect weights.

types.name: MonsterStateData
docs: session `["monsters", session]`.

types.name: OpKind
docs: `deadroll_combat::tables::OpKind`.

types.name: OpOrigin
docs: `deadroll_combat::OpOrigin`.

types.name: OpResultData
docs: `deadroll_combat::OpResult`: what one op of a resonance did.

fields.name: arg
docs: A `StateKind`, `ModKind` or `Aspect` by kind; 255 = the base's native state (or any).

types.name: PacketResultData
docs: `deadroll_combat::PacketResult`. Damage values are scaled x10_000.

fields.name: pen_attacker_bp
docs: Attacker's penetration on this packet, bp. 0 when armor does not apply.

fields.name: pen_state_bp
docs: Penetration state already on the target, bp.

fields.name: vuln_shock_bp
docs: Shock already on the target, bp.

types.name: Participation
docs: `["participation", session, character]`: one character in one party.

fields.name: core
docs: Frozen contract, first after the discriminator.

fields.name: player
docs: Main wallet (character owner) that joined and paid.

fields.name: max_ap
docs: Action points granted at the start of each own turn (from speed).

fields.name: ap_seq
docs: `GameSession.turn_seq` when `core.action_points` was last granted.

fields.name: contribution
docs: Lamports paid into the escrow, for refunds.

fields.name: cooldowns
docs: Per `SkillSet` slot: own turn starts until the skill is usable again, 0 = usable
(`rules::cooldown_after_use`; `start_turn` counts them down).

fields.name: hp_max
docs: The character's maximum HP with its gear, copied at `set_ready(true)` (heals stop here).

fields.name: mods
docs: Buffs and debuffs on this player (`deadroll_combat::support`), one slot per kind (the
Resistance is `resist_mod`); `start_turn` counts them down.

fields.name: equipment
docs: What the character wears, `ItemBase` bytes by `EquipSlot` (`EMPTY_ITEM` = none), copied
from `Character.gear` at `set_ready(true)`. The character program refuses gear changes
while the character is locked into a session, so the copy stays exact.

fields.name: skills
docs: The skills taken onto this map, `SkillSet` indexes: slots `0..4` active, `4` reactive,
`5` passive, `NO_SKILL` = empty (docs/SKILL_BUILDER.md, 3.4). Written at
`set_ready(true)` after the character program checked it; cleared by `set_ready(false)`.

fields.name: class_tier
docs: The character's class trait tier (`Character.class_tier`), copied at `set_ready(true)`
with the gear; the locked character cannot change it during the party.

fields.name: accuracy
docs: Patch 4: a resonance's accuracy buff on this player (Pale Flame), `turns == 0` = none.

fields.name: map_skills
docs: Patch 5: the skills of `skills`, slot by slot, as the rules see them (the character's
`SkillSet` record with its `SkillExtras` part), copied at `set_ready(true)`.

fields.name: resist_mod
docs: Patch 9: the Resistance on this player with its aspect weights (`mods` has the others).

types.name: ParticipationData
docs: session `["participation", session, character]`.

fields.name: actor
docs: Session key or burner allowed to act for this character.

types.name: PendingAction
docs: The roll waiting for its VRF value (`core.pending_vrf`), resolved by `consume_randomness`:
an attack, or the initiative roll of `start_session` ([`PendingAction::initiative`]).

fields.name: attacker
docs: Turn-order id of the attacker.

fields.name: target
docs: Turn-order id of the target.

fields.name: skill_slot
docs: Skill slot of a player attack, `rules::BASE_ATTACK` for the weapon; monsters: the action.

fields.name: participation
docs: The player side of the hit (attacker or target): the callback must receive exactly it.
For the initiative roll: player slot 0 (the callback's account list is fixed).

types.name: PendingMonsterReactiveData
docs: A roll that only resolves monster reactives (patch 6), requested by `move_unit` (a player
came next to monsters) or `start_turn` (over-time damage dropped a monster's HP): what
happened, and to which monsters. `kind` as [`pending_kind`].

fields.name: bearers
docs: Bit per monster index whose reactive answers.

fields.name: source
docs: Turn-order id of the unit that caused it (`EMPTY_UNIT` = none).

fields.name: victim
docs: `HP_DROP`: the monster whose HP dropped, from `hp_before` to `hp_after` of `hp_max`.

types.name: PendingReactiveData
docs: A roll that only resolves reactives, requested by `monster_move` or `start_turn` (they have
no roll of their own): what happened, and to whom.

fields.name: bearers
docs: Bit per player slot whose reactive answers.

fields.name: source
docs: Turn-order id of the unit that caused it (`EMPTY_UNIT` = none).

fields.name: victim
docs: `HP_DROP`: the player whose HP dropped, from `hp_before` to `hp_after` of `hp_max`.

types.name: PlayerDied
docs: A player reached 0 HP: out of the battle at once (no turn, no target). Since patch 6 the
tombstone (`character.mark_dead`) follows in `start_turn` or a claim, `DeathFinalized`; a death
from over-time damage in `start_turn` is final in the same instruction.

fields.name: skills
docs: The skills taken onto the map (`Participation.skills`), empty when not ready.

fields.name: hp
docs: HP with the gear, copied at ready.

types.name: Purpose
docs: Buff targets self or an ally, debuff targets an enemy.

types.name: RangeTag
docs: Range axis of a skill or a basic attack (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md, section 2).
Added in patch 5.

types.name: ReactionKind
docs: What a triggered reactive skill did (`deadroll_rules::reactive::Reaction`).

types.name: ReactiveData
docs: A player's reactive skill on the map: kept in the session, so a trigger is checked without
loading the player's accounts. `skill_slot == NO_SKILL`: none.

fields.name: skill_slot
docs: Its `SkillSet` index.

fields.name: cooldown_left
docs: Own turn starts until it can trigger again (`rules::cooldown_after_use`), counted down by
`start_turn`.

types.name: ReactiveTriggered
docs: A reactive skill triggered by itself (docs/SKILL_BUILDER.md, section 3.2), on the dice of
the action that caused it (`action_counter`, after that action's own rolls).

fields.name: bearer
docs: Player slot of the bearer.

fields.name: skill_slot
docs: The reactive skill's `SkillSet` index.

fields.name: target
docs: Turn-order id the reaction goes to: the enemy, the buffed player, or the bearer for an
aura.

fields.name: cooldown_left
docs: Own turn starts until it can trigger again.

types.name: ResistModData
docs: Patch 9: a unit's Resistance (`kind == Resistance`, `turns == 0` = none) and its aspect
weights (`deadroll_combat::TimedMod::weights_pct`). Borsh-identical to a `TimedMod`, so a hit
event mirrors its target modifiers with it too.

types.name: ResonanceData
docs: `deadroll_combat::Resonance`.

fields.name: id
docs: `base * 6 + tint`.

fields.name: second_tier
docs: Patch 4: the second tint of a triple, and a pair with no record (its tint's trait).

types.name: ResonanceSpread
docs: What a player's hit did beyond its target (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md 6.4), right after
its `HitResolved`: states that jumped to other monsters, a knockback, burning cells, and the
accuracy buff the attacker got. Only written when something happened.

fields.name: attacker
docs: Turn-order ids.

fields.name: moved
docs: The target was pushed from `moved_from` to `moved_to`.

fields.name: ignited
docs: Cells set on fire (`ignited[..ignited_count]`): Burning of `ignite_power` on whoever
steps in, through round `until_round`.

fields.name: accuracy
docs: The attacker's accuracy buff after the hit.

types.name: SkillBlocks
docs: Everything that gives a skill its mechanics. Text (name, description) is not here.

fields.name: source
docs: Power source tag. One value, so magical and martial never mix.

fields.name: form
docs: Form tag. One value, so strike and projectile never mix.

fields.name: aspects
docs: In order: the first is the main one (largest share). Only `aspect_count` are used;
unused slots must stay at the default value.

fields.name: aura_radius
docs: Aura radius in cells, `0` = not an aura (section 3.5).

types.name: SkillExt
docs: Blocks added in patch 5, stored next to [`SkillBlocks`] (a `SkillSet` record cannot grow
in place): the range and timing tags (docs/DAMAGE_TYPES_AND_MIXES.md, section 2) and the
HP threshold of a reactive trigger (docs/SKILL_BUILDER.md, section 3.2).

fields.name: range
docs: Melee or ranged: how far the skill reaches.

fields.name: timing
docs: Instant or over time. Only a tag for now (rules by tag come later).

fields.name: hp_below_pct
docs: `HpBelow` / `AllyHpBelow`: the trigger fires when HP drops below this percent of the
maximum. `0` for every other skill.

types.name: SkillUsed
docs: A player used an active skill (`act`); it is now on cooldown.

fields.name: unit
docs: Turn-order id of the player.

fields.name: cooldown
docs: The skill's cooldown: it misses this many of the player's next own turns.

fields.name: cooldowns
docs: `Participation.cooldowns` after the use: own turn starts until each slot is usable.

types.name: SpreadHitData
docs: One monster a resonance passed a state on to (`deadroll_rules::spread`).

fields.name: monster
docs: Monster index.

fields.name: states
docs: The monster's states after.

types.name: StateKind
docs: Burning, Chill, Freeze, Bleeding, Shock, Stun, then Penetration (patch 3, append only).

types.name: StateRollData
docs: `deadroll_combat::StateRoll`.

types.name: Target
docs: Area comes later (append).

types.name: TempStash
docs: `["stash", session, character]`: experience and rewards that become the character's only on
victory or peaceful exit (docs/PARTY_AND_TURNS.md, section 8).

types.name: TimedModData
docs: `deadroll_combat::TimedMod`: a buff or debuff on a unit, `turns == 0` = empty slot.

fields.name: aspect
docs: The skill's aspect (Vulnerability is to this aspect).

fields.name: turns
docs: Own turn starts of the bearer until it ends.

fields.name: source
docs: Turn-order id of the unit that applied it.

types.name: TintRollData
docs: `deadroll_combat::TintRoll`.

types.name: Trigger
docs: Section 3.2, reactive skills only.

types.name: TurnSkipped
docs: Hard control took the unit's turn: `start_turn` ended it on its own.

fields.name: state
docs: Freeze or Stun.

fields.name: unit
docs: Turn-order id: `0..4` player slot, `4 + i` monster `i`.

types.name: TurnTicked
docs: The start of a unit's turn (`start_turn`), one per turn: over-time damage, hard control,
durations and cooldowns counted down (docs/COMBAT_MATH.md, 7.5; SKILL_BUILDER.md, 8).

fields.name: unit
docs: Turn-order id.

fields.name: dot_damage
docs: Burning + Bleeding damage dealt now.

fields.name: hp
docs: HP after it.

fields.name: died
docs: The over-time damage killed the unit (`MonsterKilled` / `PlayerDied` came first).

fields.name: skipped
docs: Freeze or Stun: the turn is skipped (`TurnSkipped`, then the next `TurnStarted`).

fields.name: expired
docs: `deadroll_combat::states::state_bit` of every state that ended now.

fields.name: states
docs: The unit's states after the tick.

fields.name: cooldowns
docs: Cooldowns after the tick, own turn starts until usable: a player's by `SkillSet` slot,
a monster's by skill slot in the first `MONSTER_SLOTS` entries (patch 6).

fields.name: thaw_damage
docs: Patch 4: the part of `dot_damage` from a Freeze that thawed (Burning Frost).
